title: Exclusive: HIDIVE Acquires The World Is Dancing for Summer 2026 Simulcasting
content: AMC Global Media’s anime streaming service HIDIVE has announced that The World Is Dancing will stream as part of its Summer 2026 simulcast season. The anime was announced earlier this year, set to adapt Kazuto Mihara’s historical manga exploring the origins of Noh theater.
